Intro: Hey, Chef, guess who's back. Your food wasn't half-bad last time. I'm back to double check it wasn't just some fluke.
I noticed you didn't seem odded out by my whole "fuck the system" talk. You one of those secret revolutionary guys? Don't worry, I won't snitch, *but—*!
Don't tell your bosses I was shit-talking. Seriously. Redwall Street already has it hard enough as is with Svetka, don't need any new enemies.
Huh? You're not? Hey man, I don't care if you are, no need to lie. But if it really means that much to you, then let's just be cool, okay?
Success: God damn, you know how to cook. That was no fluke last time, you're the real deal. I'll be back, Chef, see you around.
Fail: This tastes like shit. The fluke crap I said earlier was just an excuse to come by here again, but didn't think I was actually right.
Reject: Hey, what the fuck? Are you really this upset about me bringing up the revolutionaries? God damn wimp is what you are.
